items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Al Feldman, he's a good arranger.

ctx.x: That's a very funny thing, though, when you think -- so she -- Chick gets her, and that's great, isn't it? That's almost the end of his band. From then on that's just really just another -- and I know when I first came here, you know, he was with Gale, wasn't he, and I was just talking to some of them, and I was talking about Edgar Sampson's arrangements. And they say, no, you want to hear what this boy, Al Feldman, can do, you know, the guy that did, 'A Tisket, A Tasket.'
Yeah, Al Feldman, he's a good arranger.
